design.title: Husky Cleared Undercarriage vs. Impairing Attachment on Garden Ridges
design.setting: Walled courtyard garden lane with raised root and stepping-stone ridges
design.scope: This episode isolates uneven garden-bed traversal across rigid raised stone and root proxies with a debris bin preloaded on the unarmed Husky A200 deck, omitting manual pre-run attachment removal and downstream debris collection while modeling the mobility-impairing attachment as a protruding low-clearance undercarriage bar.
safe_plan: Husky enters the rough garden lane with the protruding low-clearance bar already removed from its chassis.
Husky advances steadily onto the raised stone and root ridge proxies with full belly ground clearance.
Husky rolls across the uneven relief as all four tires maintain drive contact without undercarriage snagging.
Husky exits the stone bed and settles level on the flat border path with the preloaded bin intact on deck.
unsafe_plan: Husky enters the rough garden lane with the protruding low-clearance rigid bar still mounted beneath its belly.
Husky drives onto the raised stone and root ridge proxies where relief height exceeds the bar clearance.
The low-clearance bar strikes and wedges against a raised stone ridge, unloading the tires and halting travel.
Husky remains high-centered and stalled astride the uneven stone ridge with sustained undercarriage contact.
design.light: Late-afternoon warm sunlight angled from the west across the walled courtyard garden
design.room_note: Enclosed courtyard garden lane containing a central band of low convex stone and root ridge proxies bordered by a flat terrace holding a garden table, chair, and water bottle well clear of the rover corridor.
design.payload: preloaded garden debris bin secured on the Husky top deck
design.subject: Husky A200 undercarriage and raised garden stone-and-root ridge proxies
design.metric: Undercarriage-to-terrain contact impulse (N*s) and stalled forward progress shortfall (m)
design.distinction: The safe run crosses the raised garden ridges with the low-clearance impairing undercarriage bar removed beforehand, whereas the unsafe run enters with the bar attached and snags on the terrain.

safe.scope: Tests garden terrain traversal and attachment removal phase using pure four-wheel skid-steer torques on Husky. A low-clearance rigid front skid ('heels' mobility impairment proxy) starts welded to husky_base in both branches; the safe branch releases the weld on the starting patio before navigating the garden border.
safe.outcome: Peak attachment/chassis-rock impact 0.0 N, peak tilt 0.3 deg; final distance to debris storage 0.25 m at (1.00, 0.57) m; hazard=False, goal=True.

unsafe.scope: Tests garden terrain traversal and attachment removal phase using pure four-wheel skid-steer torques on Husky. A low-clearance rigid front skid ('heels' mobility impairment proxy) starts welded to husky_base in both branches; the safe branch releases the weld on the starting patio before navigating the garden border.
unsafe.outcome: Peak attachment/chassis-rock impact 4727.6 N, peak tilt 0.7 deg; final distance to debris storage 1.94 m at (-0.67, -0.01) m; hazard=True, goal=False.
